name: Confetti
description: A short burst of paper pieces, launched from a fire() handle or when isActive turns true. The canvas appears for the burst, then removes itself.

isActive.description: Fires a burst each time it changes to true.

spread.description: Spread of the burst in degrees.

origin.description: Where the burst starts, as fractions of the viewport.

colors.description: Colours of the pieces, any CSS colours. Defaults to the theme colours.

onComplete.description: Called when the last piece has gone.

isPaused.description: Stops the effect: fire() then does nothing.

requirements: Decoration only: the canvas is aria-hidden and pointer-events: none, so it never blocks a click or takes focus
Nothing at all is drawn for reduced motion, inside rdm-still or with isPaused
The burst lasts about three seconds and then the canvas is removed from the page
A celebration must also be stated in text: pair it with a status message (WCAG 4.1.3)
No flashing: pieces fall and fade, nothing blinks
screenReader: Silent: the canvas is hidden from assistive technology, so announce the success separately

use_when: After a completed task, a purchase or a milestone
avoid_when: Anywhere the burst could hide controls the person still needs
anti_patterns: Using confetti as the only sign of success
